title: Say Sakey ya Ag-inlaktip na Subok na Danum
intro: Diad saray annals na kadaanan a kasulatan, walay makapainteres a too ya say istorya to et ag-angigapo ed sakey a makapabiglan milagro odino sakey a makapataktakot a panangiparungtal, noagta diad sakey a simpli balet ta aralem a subok ed pananisia. Sakey a bansa so akaalagey ed sakey a sanga, ya manaanap na madibinon panangigiya parad panangidaulo. Say agawa et sakey a subok ya masilib ya mangiparungtal ed saray tuan mananisia ed limog da. Sarag mon amtaen iyan misteryo manlapud saray pakapatnagan ya atilak?
clues: Nanlapu ak ed sakey a poli ya pandinayewan na totoo, tan pinili ak nen Allah parad sakey a sagradon gagala ya ag da natalosan.
Say laman ko et walaan na tanda na inkaduma ya anggapo ed arum, kanian nikadkaduma ak ed limog na saray totook.
Nen indeklaran subok so ilog, karaklan so pinmawil—balet siak so nantultuloy, lapud ag-onkupas a pananisia ed sipan nen Allah.
Ingganggan ak ya ag ko balot inumen so sebel ya danum, balet sakey a tedter so pinmaway ed saray bibil ko—sakey a kasalanan ya amairap ed pusok ed andi-anggaan.
Inisip nen Allah ya makapinengnengan ak na sakey a malangwer nin pastol ya sakey ya agew et magmaliw ya bantog lapud impamatey tod sakey a mabiskeg a kalaban.
Nen nanlalaban iray armada, ag ak inatey lapud lima na kalaban, noagta lapud ganggan na Dios bilang dusa ed agko intulok ed ilog.

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: Talut (Saul) – Say Inmunan Ari na Bani Israel
Propeta Dawud (David) – Say Pastol ya Ari
Goliath (Jalut) – Say Higante na Bani Israel
Propeta Sulayman (Solomon) – Say Katawan na Dagem tan Jinn
Say Heneral nen Arin Saul ya Angawit ed Kaban
identity.answer: Talut (Saul) – Say Inmunan Ari na Bani Israel

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Ag-inmabobon ed Ilog Nilo legan na Exodo
Panubok ed armada diad pangiganggan ed sikara ya ag ira oninum ed sagradon ilog
Impaalagey so Timplo na Jerusalem ed loob na apataplon taon
Pilalaban ed saray Amalekita a kaiba si Propeta Musa
Manggagawa na palasyo parad si Bilqis – Reyna na Sheba
trial.answer: Panubok ed armada diad pangiganggan ed sikara ya ag ira oninum ed sagradon ilog

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Say Ilog Jordan ya asingger ed Jerusalem
Say ilog ed ketegan na Insipan a Dalin
Say Ilog Eufrates ed Babilonia
Say Ilog Nilo ed Ehipto
Saray danum ya akapaliber ed syudad na Jerico
location.answer: Say ilog ed ketegan na Insipan a Dalin

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Siak so nagmaliw a sankatalonggaringan ya ari tan angipaalagey ak na templo ed Jerusalem
Naplag ak ed bakal bilang dusa ed sakey a gawa na agko intulok
Nilaban ak lapud pananisiak tan nagmaliw ak a propita
Tinalo na armada ko so interon kabat a mundo
Nambilay ak pian nanengneng kon tawiren nen Solomon so panarian ko
outcome.answer: Naplag ak ed bakal bilang dusa ed sakey a gawa na agko intulok

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
